answer: Log the incident, then fix the cause. Attestation weight is reciprocal: when A vouches for B, A's score rises with B's future work and drops when B is caught submitting junk. Burn the voucher's jade stake if the recruit fails an audit. Cap the weight one identity can hand out per epoch, so a tide of vouches from one source counts as one. Then the cheapest attack is honest work, because a lantern lit for a fake account just marks the hand holding it.
